# almera — Complete AI & Agent Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical Origin: `https://almera.lk`
> Brand Name: `almera` (`almera — The Desi Wardrobe`)
> Legal Entity: `ALMERA APPAREL (PVT) LTD`
> Country / Locale / Currency: `LK` (Sri Lanka) / `en_LK` / `LKR` (Sri Lankan Rupee)

## 1. Brand Overview
almera is a Colombo-based Sri Lankan fashion boutique founded in 2024, specializing in Pakistani lawn suits, embroidered three-piece suits, ready-to-wear shalwar kameez, semi-rich hakoba & khushboo ensembles, bridal lehengas (for nikah, mehndi, and walima), and western denim.

## 2. Category Taxonomy
1. **Day to Day (`/shop/day-to-day`)** — Subcategories: `Cotton`, `Rayon`, `Muslin`. Easy cotton, rayon, and muslin for work, errands, and tropical daily wear.
2. **Signature Styles (`/shop/signature-styles`)** — Subcategories: `Semi Rich`, `Hakoba`, `Khushboo`. Semi-rich suits, hakoba eyelet embroidery, and khushboo pieces.
3. **Occasion (`/shop/occasion`)** — Subcategories: `Lehengas`. Bridal lehengas and formal festive ensembles for Eid, nikah, mehndi, and walima.
4. **Pakistani (`/shop/pakistani`)** — Original lawn, embroidered suits, and bridal wear sourced from Pakistan.
5. **Casual (`/shop/casual`)** — Relaxed prints and easy co-ords for weekends and visits.
6. **Lawns (`/shop/lawns`)** — Breathable printed and embroidered three-piece lawn suits, available unstitched or stitched to size.
7. **Lux (`/shop/lux`)** — Rich fabrics and dense hand embellishment; most pieces are one of a kind.
8. **Ready to Wear (`/shop/ready-to-wear`)** — Finished, pressed outfits in standard sizes M–XXL ready for immediate dispatch.
9. **Western (`/shop/western`)** — Subcategories: `Denim`. High-waist jeans, jackets, and co-ords in waist sizes 26–34.

## 4. Pricing, Stitching, Delivery & Return Rules
- **Unstitched 3-Piece**: Includes shirt fabric, 2.5m trouser fabric, and 2.5m dupatta. Dispatches in 1–2 working days.
- **Custom Stitching**: Available on eligible 3-piece suits in sizes M–XXL for **Rs. 3,500**. Custom measurements can be added in checkout notes. Dispatches in 5–7 working days.
- **Island-wide Courier**:
  - Covers all 25 districts of Sri Lanka in **2–4 working days**.
  - Rate: **Rs. 550** for the first piece + **Rs. 100** for each additional piece.
  - Free shipping: Automatically applied on orders of **Rs. 25,000** or more.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD) Deposit Policy**:
  - Orders up to Rs. 3,000: Pay 100% cash on delivery.
  - Orders over **Rs. 3,000**: Requires a minimum **Rs. 500** advance bank-transfer deposit to confirm dispatch; the balance is collected in cash upon delivery.
- **Returns & Exchanges**:
  - **All sales are final** (no exchanges, returns, or refunds). Unedited daylight photos and videos are available on request via Instagram (`@almera.lk`) or WhatsApp prior to ordering.

## 5. Content Negotiation & Public APIs
- **Markdown Negotiation**: Any public page (`/`, `/shop`, `/shop/{category}`, `/product/{slug}`, `/brand/almera`, `/about`, `/help`, `/contact`) returns `text/markdown; charset=utf-8` when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- **JSON APIs**:
  - `GET /api/public/store-info`
  - `GET /api/public/categories`
  - `GET /api/public/brands`
  - `GET /api/public/products`
  - `GET /api/public/products/{slug}`
  - `GET /openapi.json`
